title: Category page, default: the listing alone
when: The default category and collection page, used by every category without a variant of its own.
evidence: the listing alone between header and footer on about 3 in 5 default category pages

steps.note: `listing-large-cards-3col` for 3:4 model photos; `listing-gallery-5col-gapless` for objects on one plate. Pair with the theme card (`card-packshot` or `card-lifestyle`).

notes: Always write the filter position (`filters.position`, or the root `filtersPosition` in a section stored at version 1791195496953 or older): settings that leave it out draw the inline sidebar.
SEO text belongs in the cabinet SEO fields, or in RichText after the listing on a per-category variant, never on the default variant (it would repeat on every category).
Seeded category names, categories shorter than one row and one photo reused as several covers are merchant tasks in the cabinet.
